external_collaboration.evidence_quote: Anonymous Content has partnered with UK-based not-for-profit organization ADCAN for the creative organization’s fourth-annual competition for unsigned filmmakers and animators to create original films for one of six partner charities addressing issues such as the refugee crisis, gender equality, food waste, and the environment.

The free-to-enter competition invites unsigned filmmakers and animators from across the globe to create an original 60- or 30-second film inspired by a brief from one of ADCAN’s six partner charities (The Helen Bamber Foundation, The Fawcett Society, City Harvest, WERK for Peace, Grid Alternatives and The National Eating Disorders Association) to help promote their cause.

Anonymous Content announced that it will be launching a Web3 series and game titled “Ghosts of The Deep” (GOTD) in partnership with Emmy award-winning director producer and writer Philip Gelatt. The Sci-Fi adventure game and series will be brought to life through blockchain infrastructure provider OP3N.
